description: The Daihatsu Mira Cocoa  is a kei car built by the Japanese carmaker Daihatsu from 2009 to 2018. Based on the L275 series Mira, it replaced the Mira Gino in the Daihatsu's lineup, complete with retro-inspired styling. With its cute, "warm and modern" design, Daihatsu was explicitly aiming at female buyers. It was launched in August 2009 and went on sale in September. The name "Cocoa" comes from hot cocoa and was intended to convey a warm, relaxing atmosphere.
